template: standin (2 elements, fade transition, 960-wide proxy footage, IBM Plex Sans text, logo image)
machine: Josh's Windows 11 laptop; in-app Chromium browser pane driven by Claude Code
method: Open the editor with ?perf=<seconds>. The Player is played from frame 0 for that long while 'frameupdate' events are counted (app/src/perf.ts). The number is what the eye sees.
environmentNote: The in-app browser pane only paints while the desktop app window is on screen. Every run except the first happened while it was occluded, so the Player's animation loop was paused and no frames were counted. Runs with environment 'visible' are the only ones that count toward the target; a run on Josh's own browser tab is still needed.
